title: PAR sheet (machine-readable) — math/reports/par-sheet.json
description: Machine-readable PAR sheet produced from release-level simulation. All statistics are MEASURED values, reported exactly as simulated (honesty rule) — never targets. The human-readable PAR sheet document (docs/par-sheet.md) is rendered from this data.

metadata.description: Identity and versioning of the game this PAR sheet describes.

gameName.description: Public display name of the game.

gameVersion.description: Semver of the game package the sheet was simulated against.

mathVersion.description: Semver of the math model the sheet was simulated against.

configHash.description: Canonical config hash of the exact configs simulated.

rtpProfileId.description: RTP profile this sheet covers; one PAR sheet per profile.

seedPolicy.description: How simulation seeds were chosen and recorded, e.g. "fixed seeds, numpy PCG64, one seed per worker, listed in simulationProvenance.seeds".

symbolInventory.description: Per-reel symbol counts of the BASE reel set (one map per reel, left to right). Strip games: occurrences on the strip; weighted games: integer weights.

items.description: Map from symbol id to its count/weight on this reel.

^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,15}$.description: Occurrences (strip) or weight (weighted table) of this symbol on this reel.

rtpContributions.description: Measured RTP split by win source, as fractions of total bet. base + feature + super_feature + ultimate_feature + scatterPay (+ jackpot) must equal total ±0.0005 (validation gate).

jackpot.description: Measured jackpot contribution. Omit when the game has no jackpots.

hitFrequency.description: Measured fraction of rounds with any win (win > 0).

featureFrequencies.description: Measured natural trigger frequency of each tier, expressed as N in "1 in N" rounds.

volatility.description: Measured dispersion statistics of per-round x-bet returns.

index.description: Volatility index (industry-style, derived from the standard deviation and confidence level).

standardDeviation.description: Standard deviation of per-round return in x-bet units.

class.description: Volatility class the measured index falls into.

payoutPercentiles.description: Percentiles of the per-round total win distribution, in x-bet units (0 = losing round).

maxWinProbability.description: Measured (or rare-event-estimated) per-round probability of reaching the max-win cap. Must be > 0: the cap must be reachable.

confidenceIntervals.description: Statistical uncertainty of the headline measurements at the stated confidence level.

rtpHalfWidth.description: Half-width of the RTP confidence interval (absolute, fraction of bet). The tolerance gate compares |simRTP - targetRTP| against this.

hitFrequencyHalfWidth.description: Half-width of the hit-frequency confidence interval.

maxWinProbabilityHalfWidth.description: Half-width of the max-win probability estimate (wide when estimated by plain Monte Carlo).

simulationProvenance.description: Full reproducibility block per CONVENTIONS §5 — enough to re-run the exact simulation.

gameVersion.description: Game package semver at simulation time.

mathVersion.description: Math model semver at simulation time.

configHash.description: Canonical config hash at simulation time.

simCodeVersion.description: Version/commit of the simulation code (semver or VCS revision).

lockfileHash.description: sha256 of the uv lockfile pinning the simulation environment.

seeds.description: RNG seeds used (numpy PCG64), one per worker/stream.

rounds.description: Total simulated rounds (dev minimum 1e6; release sizes are larger per the simulation policy).

command.description: Exact command line, e.g. "uv run python -m slot_math.simulate --profile rtp-96 --rounds 100000000 ...".

rtpFraction.description: One win source's RTP contribution as a fraction of total bet.

oneInN.description: Frequency expressed as N in "1 in N" rounds (e.g. 187.4).

xBetAmount.description: A win amount expressed as a multiple of total bet.

minorUnits.description: Monetary amount in integer minor units (e.g. cents). Never a binary float.

tierId.description: Canonical scatter feature tier id (3 / 4 / 5+ scatters).

symbolId.description: Canonical symbol id, e.g. WILD, SCATTER, H1, L3, JP_GRAND.

projectSlug.description: Kebab-case project slug used for games/<slug>/.
